categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sales of blast furnace slag powder, blast furnace cement, and special purpose materials. It also engages in resource recycling business including steel slag and mineral fine materials, and provides waste steel trading and electronic industry calcium fluoride sludge recycling. Subsidiaries focus on iron powder sales, fly ash trading, real estate leasing, and slag sales in Vietnam.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes water-quenched blast furnace slag grinding, processing of steelmaking by-products such as converter slag and mineral fine materials, and advanced recycling technologies. It emphasizes low-carbon cement and materials development, inorganic polymer technology, and promotes energy-efficient production methods including ISO 50001 energy management and ISO 14001 environmental management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include ready-mixed concrete plants, construction companies, building material dealers, and public engineering projects such as infrastructure, transportation, and maritime engineering. The company also serves steel mills as a supplier of recycled raw materials and targets semiconductor industry by recycling calcium fluoride sludge.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with multiple manufacturing plants and logistics centers in Kaohsiung, Taichung, and other regions. The company also has overseas operations in Vietnam and imports raw materials from countries including Japan, South Korea, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the steel and construction materials supply chain, processing steelmaking by-products into value-added construction materials and recycled products. It also engages in upstream procurement of raw materials and downstream sales and distribution to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing low-carbon cement and materials, enhancing resource recycling technologies, and expanding applications of steel slag in asphalt, cement raw materials, and maritime engineering. The company invests in R&D for carbon reduction technologies, product quality improvement, and sustainable circular economy solutions aligned with net-zero carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of blast furnace slag powder, blast furnace cement, special materials, and recycled resource products. Additional income comes from subcontracted production, trading of waste steel and fly ash, and service contracts related to material processing and logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's blast furnace slag and cement industry, competing with around 11 other domestic producers. It benefits from stable raw material supply agreements with major steel producers and holds certifications that differentiate its products as environmentally friendly and high quality. Market competition is moderate with some pressure from low-cost imports and international steel market fluctuations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$13.29 billion in the latest fiscal year, with net profit increasing by 38% year-over-year. It maintains a stable asset base of around NT$11.8 billion and equity of NT$6.65 billion. The company shows steady growth supported by increased sales volumes and improved operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, low-carbon green building materials with certifications such as recycled green building labels and carbon footprint verification. It offers high-quality, stable products tailored to customer needs, supported by strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive customer service. Its strategic integration with steel producers ensures reliable raw material supply and competitive cost advantages.
